status: DECIDED — the values below are owner-approved methodological decisions, recorded before registration. Protocol-004 does not define them and the tooling does not choose them. This file is part of the tooling aggregate, so these values are frozen by registration; `analyze` refuses to run while any value is UNDECIDED.

AD-1.protocol_basis: §12 'Agreement: Krippendorff's α, nominal, ≥ 0.667' — the set of observations over which α is computed is not stated
AD-1.question: Is α computed over every observation both raters labelled, or only over observations that are not machine-INVALID, sealed REFERENCE-CONFLICT or REFERENCE-STALE?

AD-2.protocol_basis: §15.5(3) 'Nominal α < 0.667' — α is undefined when the raters used a single label for every item (no expected disagreement) or rated nothing
AD-2.question: When α is undefined, does condition 3 trigger INCONCLUSIVE, or is α treated as not below the threshold?

AD-3.protocol_basis: §9.8 'reference and CPG cite the same document'; §12.3 performs no URL normalisation for the cited set
AD-3.question: Is 'the same document' the reference source_url being byte-identical to a cited URL, or identical after removing a '#fragment'?

AD-4.protocol_basis: §15.5(4) 'held-out companies had their decisive registry path unavailable during the run' — the response records registryUnavailable entries per provider/identifier
AD-4.question: Does any registryUnavailable entry count, or only an entry whose identifier equals the company's pre-registered decisive identifier?

AD-5.protocol_basis: §10.2 'as_of_date no more than 24 months before the run asOf'
AD-5.question: Is the cutoff the same calendar day 24 months before asOf (clamped to month end), or asOf minus 730 days?

AD-6.protocol_basis: §10.2 'reference truth is the most recent authoritative value … If none exists that recent, the observation is REFERENCE-STALE' — a NOT_AVAILABLE_FROM_SOURCE record holds no value
AD-6.question: Does the temporal rule apply only to STATED reference values, or to every reference record of employee_count / revenue_range?

AD-7.topic: Outcome of a declared protocol violation
AD-7.protocol_basis: §15.5(7) lists a mid-run protocol violation as INCONCLUSIVE; §18 halt condition 3 says 'The run is void, not repaired'
AD-7.question: Is a declared protocol violation (other than a §6.5 execution-audit violation, which is always VOID) reported as INCONCLUSIVE or VOID?

AD-8.protocol_basis: §10.3 P2 AR = CORRECT-ABSTENTION ÷ (CORRECT-ABSTENTION + UNSUPPORTED-FILL) — undefined when the denominator is 0
AD-8.question: When AR is undefined, is P2 not met (FAILURE-eligible) or is the run INCONCLUSIVE?

AD-9.protocol_basis: §10.3 'Abstentions are reported split into source unavailable vs other' — unavailability is recorded per response, not per field
AD-9.question: Is an abstention 'source unavailable' when its response records any unavailable source or registry, or only an unavailable registry?
